title: Record a durable "waiting on X by T, owner O" handoff on an item that the host can scan for overdue successors
outcome: Record a durable "waiting on X by T, owner O" handoff on an item that the host can scan for overdue successors
acceptance: A holder can record on its item, through the existing words, a durable wait: what it waits on (a named successor event or a message), a deadline, and a recovery owner session. The record survives restarts and is attributed and audited like other item records.

The host, or any project-bound session, can list overdue waits (deadline passed, wait not resolved) through a bounded read without claiming the item. The listing names the item, the awaited event, the deadline and the recovery owner.

Resolving or superseding a wait is explicit and idempotent, and a retried record or resolution never duplicates or loses evidence. Covered by deterministic tests, including a missed-wake case where the awaited event never arrives and the overdue listing reports it after the deadline.
No store-format migration unless justified and approved; if one is needed, the design says so before coding and follows full store migration rules.
